bios.$comment: main.c:64-68 tries the four names in this order and takes the first that reads as exactly 1024 bytes, so any one of them satisfies the core -- they are four machine models, not four separate requirements.

description.en: The 1 KB console boot ROM, read from /bios/videopac/. Required: nothing runs without it. Any one of the four will do, and the one present decides which machine the core emulates -- o2rom.bin is the Magnavox Odyssey2 (G7000), c52.bin the Philips Videopac C52, g7400.bin the European Videopac+ G7400, jopac.bin the French Jopac. The G7400 images add the extra video modes a handful of Videopac+ titles use.
